market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$78,300 would need a ~42% drawdown to $45k by year-end. Historical 8-month drawdowns of that magnitude have happened in bear regimes but are not base-rate now with ETF inflows and strengthening momentum.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of any macro-driven crypto bear market
